verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product catalog, so a merchant feed or import path is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents only the consumer side: developers and agents search, look up and track products across an aggregated catalog. Nothing documents a feed, upload or import API that lets a merchant publish its own catalog.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell
